name: decko-ts
description: TypeScript implementation of the Decko card engine. A derivative work of decko-commons/decko (card 1.110.0 / decko 0.20.0), licensed GPL-3.0-or-later; see NOTICE. Parity against the Ruby engine is byte-for-byte and is re-measured per release — see README for the current measured figure and how to reproduce it. Edge-native (Cloudflare D1, libSQL/Bunny).

DB.description: Your deck. The deploy creates this D1 database for you and fills it with the core schema plus a small 4-card demo deck (`Home`, `Hello World`, `About`). Read-only in the demo — the Worker never writes a CARD to it (sign-in still records a session row).

scripts.test:gates: node tools/test-gates.mjs list && node tools/test-gates.mjs check
scripts.db:migrations:apply: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && npx wrangler deploy
